# matrix_expect.txt -- the ownership matrix's expectations, the input of
# tests/unit/matrixgen.z (`make regen-matrix`). Every family crossed with every
# position is a cell; a cell no row selects is RUN: it returns its number and
# frees everything it made. A row is
#
#   selector  position  verdict  [detail]
#
# selector   a family, `*`, or a group: @ref @val @constructible @sum
#            @interface @generic @typedef @native
# verdict    RUN; REFUSED with `Ennnn message` (@N -- the type as the
#            compiler names it, its canonical spelling); NA with the reason
#            the cell cannot be written; ASK with the open question; KNOWN
#            with the defect that keeps the cell from doing what it should
#            (ASK and KNOWN cells are emitted nowhere in the fixtures)
#
# The LAST row selecting a cell decides it.

# -- a borrow locks its source for the borrow's life
*              borrow_then_write      REFUSED  E0200 Cannot assign to 'x': shared lock held by 'b'
@ref           field_borrow_write     REFUSED  E0200 Cannot assign to 'h.f': shared lock held by 'b'
*              list_iter_write        REFUSED  E0200 Cannot take exclusive lock on 'xs': already has shared lock held by 'e'
@ref           list_get_write         REFUSED  E0200 Cannot take exclusive lock on 'xs': already has shared lock held by 'g'
@ref           map_get_write          REFUSED  E0200 Cannot take exclusive lock on 'm': already has shared lock held by 'g'
@ref           proj_borrow_write      REFUSED  E0200 Cannot assign to 'x': exclusive lock held by 'p'
@ref           with_borrow_write      REFUSED  E0200 Cannot assign to 'x': shared lock held by 'w'
*              conf_label_write       REFUSED  E0200 Cannot assign to 'x': exclusive lock held by 'p'
*              conf_borrow_write      REFUSED  E0200 Cannot assign to 'x': exclusive lock held by 'p'

# -- a `.borrow` binding of a value type is refused: the binding copies
@val           borrow_then_write      REFUSED  E0200 '@N' is a value type: the binding copies it, so `.borrow` has nothing to borrow
@val           borrow_then_read       REFUSED  E0200 '@N' is a value type: the binding copies it, so `.borrow` has nothing to borrow
@val           borrow_after           REFUSED  E0200 '@N' is a value type: the binding copies it, so `.borrow` has nothing to borrow
@val           field_borrow_write     REFUSED  E0200 '@N' is a value type: the binding copies it, so `.borrow` has nothing to borrow
@val           field_borrow_sibling   REFUSED  E0200 '@N' is a value type: the binding copies it, so `.borrow` has nothing to borrow

# -- a moved source is gone -- a reftype's; taking a value copies its bytes and
#    leaves the source as it is (callables arc D16)
@ref           param_take_then_read   REFUSED  E0200 cannot use 'x' after ownership transfer

# -- an unmarked projection bound to a name borrows its source EXCLUSIVELY, as
#    `.borrow` does; a value-type source is copied, and stays readable
@ref           proj_bare_then_read    REFUSED  E0200 Cannot take shared lock on 'x': already has exclusive lock held by 'p'
@ref           proj_create_then_read  REFUSED  E0200 Cannot take shared lock on 'x': already has exclusive lock held by 'p'
@ref           conf_bare_then_read    REFUSED  E0200 Cannot take shared lock on 'x': already has exclusive lock held by 'p'

# -- a reftype field never moves out: a swap takes it (Q3)
@ref           field_take             REFUSED  E0200 Cannot move borrowed variable 'h.f' with '.take' — borrowed names stay bound to their source for the full scope; copy with '.copy' to keep the source

# -- a label projection names a conformance; a typedef is not one
*              proj_label             REFUSED  E0100 type '@N' has no member 'PjLabel'

# -- a member the type does not declare is refused
*              unknown_member         REFUSED  E0100 type '@N' has no member 'zork'

# -- a sum is built through an arm: its name given a value constructs nothing
*              type_name_ctor         NA       a record or class constructs field by field, an interface projects and a native builds from its own create; other positions cover each
@sum           type_name_ctor         REFUSED  E0300 cannot construct '@N': a union/variant selects an arm

# -- a `.borrow` of a value type is refused wherever the value is copied: a
#    typedef built from it and a `with` as much as a binding (Q1)
@val           proj_borrow            REFUSED  E0200 '@N' is a value type: the binding copies it, so `.borrow` has nothing to borrow
@val           proj_borrow_write      REFUSED  E0200 '@N' is a value type: the binding copies it, so `.borrow` has nothing to borrow
@val           proj_borrow_after      REFUSED  E0200 '@N' is a value type: the binding copies it, so `.borrow` has nothing to borrow
@val           with_borrow            REFUSED  E0200 '@N' is a value type: the binding copies it, so `.borrow` has nothing to borrow
@val           with_borrow_write      REFUSED  E0200 '@N' is a value type: the binding copies it, so `.borrow` has nothing to borrow
@val           with_borrow_after      REFUSED  E0200 '@N' is a value type: the binding copies it, so `.borrow` has nothing to borrow

# -- a reassignment keeps the mode the name was bound with
@ref           repoint_take           REFUSED  E0200 Cannot reassign borrowed 'b' with an owned value: a reassignment keeps the ownership its target was bound with
@ref           reassign_bare          REFUSED  E0200 Cannot reassign owned 'x' with a borrowed value: a reassignment keeps the ownership its target was bound with
@ref           field_reassign_bare    REFUSED  E0200 Cannot reassign owned 'h.f' with a borrowed value: a reassignment keeps the ownership its target was bound with

# -- cells that cannot be written
map            operator_lvalue        NA       Map declares no operator
map            operator_rvalue        NA       Map declares no operator
option         operator_lvalue        NA       Option declares no operator
option         operator_rvalue        NA       Option declares no operator
result         operator_lvalue        NA       Result declares no operator
result         operator_rvalue        NA       Result declares no operator
set            operator_lvalue        NA       Set declares no operator
set            operator_rvalue        NA       Set declares no operator
option         method_rvalue_arg      NA       Option declares no method with an argument
result         method_rvalue_arg      NA       Result declares no method with an argument
option         this_method_arg        NA       Option declares no method with an argument
result         this_method_arg        NA       Result declares no method with an argument
map            this_operator          NA       Map declares no operator
set            this_operator          NA       Set declares no operator
option         this_operator          NA       Option declares no operator
result         this_operator          NA       Result declares no operator
@native        operand_lvalue         NA       a native type declares no operator taking itself
@native        operand_rvalue         NA       a native type declares no operator taking itself
@native        operand_inline         NA       a native type declares no operator taking itself
@native        operand_lent           NA       a native type declares no operator taking itself

@native        operand_view_inline    NA       a native type declares no operator taking itself
@native        operand_view_lent      NA       a native type declares no operator taking itself
@interface     operand_lvalue         NA       an interface's method cannot take the interface itself
@interface     operand_rvalue         NA       an interface's method cannot take the interface itself
@interface     operand_inline         NA       an interface's method cannot take the interface itself
@interface     operand_lent           NA       an interface's method cannot take the interface itself
@interface     operand_view_lvalue    NA       an interface's method cannot take the interface itself
@interface     operand_view_rvalue    NA       an interface's method cannot take the interface itself
@interface     operand_view_inline    NA       an interface's method cannot take the interface itself
@interface     operand_view_lent      NA       an interface's method cannot take the interface itself
*              predicate_rvalue       NA       an arm predicate needs a sum type
@sum           predicate_rvalue       RUN
@generic       conf_label             NA       a generic conforms through a generic spec per instance; gprotocol and gfacet cover it
@generic       conf_label_write       NA       a generic conforms through a generic spec per instance; gprotocol and gfacet cover it
@generic       conf_create            NA       a generic conforms through a generic spec per instance; gprotocol and gfacet cover it
@generic       conf_bare              NA       a generic conforms through a generic spec per instance; gprotocol and gfacet cover it
@generic       conf_borrow            NA       a generic conforms through a generic spec per instance; gprotocol and gfacet cover it
@generic       conf_borrow_write      NA       a generic conforms through a generic spec per instance; gprotocol and gfacet cover it
@generic       conf_bare_then_read    NA       a generic conforms through a generic spec per instance; gprotocol and gfacet cover it
@interface     conf_label             NA       an interface value is already a projection; it conforms to nothing
@interface     conf_label_write       NA       an interface value is already a projection; it conforms to nothing
@interface     conf_create            NA       an interface value is already a projection; it conforms to nothing
@interface     conf_bare              NA       an interface value is already a projection; it conforms to nothing
@interface     conf_borrow            NA       an interface value is already a projection; it conforms to nothing
@interface     conf_borrow_write      NA       an interface value is already a projection; it conforms to nothing
@interface     conf_bare_then_read    NA       an interface value is already a projection; it conforms to nothing
@native        conf_label             NA       a native type declares no conformance
@native        conf_label_write       NA       a native type declares no conformance
@native        conf_create            NA       a native type declares no conformance
@native        conf_bare              NA       a native type declares no conformance
@native        conf_borrow            NA       a native type declares no conformance
@native        conf_borrow_write      NA       a native type declares no conformance
@native        conf_bare_then_read    NA       a native type declares no conformance

# -- a value type's `.borrow` field is refused where it is declared: the class holds
#    its copy, as a binding of one does
@val           borrowed_field         REFUSED  E0200 '@N' is a value type: the field holds its copy, so `.borrow` has nothing to borrow
@val           borrowed_field_method  REFUSED  E0200 '@N' is a value type: the field holds its copy, so `.borrow` has nothing to borrow

# -- a conformer standing in for Rd with no projection of its own: the cells a
#    family that cannot conform cannot write
@generic       conf_fn_arg            NA       a generic conforms through a generic spec per instance; gprotocol and gfacet cover it

# -- a conformer that is reference data cannot stand in where the place OWNS the value:
#    the box would share it (the checker's owning refusal); a value type's is copied in
class          conf_field_owned       REFUSED  E0100 '@N' cannot stand in for Rd where the value is owned: write `Rd.create from: x.take`
class          conf_list              REFUSED  E0100 '@N' cannot stand in for Rd where the value is owned: write `Rd.create from: x.take`
class          conf_param_take        REFUSED  E0100 '@N' cannot stand in for Rd where the value is owned: write `Rd.create from: x.take`
class          conf_return            REFUSED  E0100 '@N' cannot stand in for Rd where the value is owned: write `Rd.create from: x.take`
class          conf_reassign          REFUSED  E0200 Cannot reassign owned 'p' with a borrowed value: a reassignment keeps the ownership its target was bound with
union          conf_field_owned       REFUSED  E0100 '@N' cannot stand in for Rd where the value is owned: write `Rd.create from: x.take`
union          conf_list              REFUSED  E0100 '@N' cannot stand in for Rd where the value is owned: write `Rd.create from: x.take`
union          conf_param_take        REFUSED  E0100 '@N' cannot stand in for Rd where the value is owned: write `Rd.create from: x.take`
union          conf_return            REFUSED  E0100 '@N' cannot stand in for Rd where the value is owned: write `Rd.create from: x.take`
union          conf_reassign          REFUSED  E0200 Cannot reassign owned 'p' with a borrowed value: a reassignment keeps the ownership its target was bound with
tclass         conf_field_owned       REFUSED  E0100 '@N' cannot stand in for Rd where the value is owned: write `Rd.create from: x.take`
tclass         conf_list              REFUSED  E0100 '@N' cannot stand in for Rd where the value is owned: write `Rd.create from: x.take`
tclass         conf_param_take        REFUSED  E0100 '@N' cannot stand in for Rd where the value is owned: write `Rd.create from: x.take`
tclass         conf_return            REFUSED  E0100 '@N' cannot stand in for Rd where the value is owned: write `Rd.create from: x.take`
tclass         conf_reassign          REFUSED  E0200 Cannot reassign owned 'p' with a borrowed value: a reassignment keeps the ownership its target was bound with

# -- a family declared in its unit conforms to nothing here: Rd is declared beside the
#    program, not in the unit
@unit          conf_label             NA       Rd is declared beside the program; the unit's type does not conform to it
@unit          conf_label_write       NA       Rd is declared beside the program; the unit's type does not conform to it
@unit          conf_create            NA       Rd is declared beside the program; the unit's type does not conform to it
@unit          conf_bare              NA       Rd is declared beside the program; the unit's type does not conform to it
@unit          conf_bare_then_read    NA       Rd is declared beside the program; the unit's type does not conform to it
@unit          conf_borrow            NA       Rd is declared beside the program; the unit's type does not conform to it
@unit          conf_borrow_write      NA       Rd is declared beside the program; the unit's type does not conform to it
@unit          conf_fn_arg            NA       Rd is declared beside the program; the unit's type does not conform to it
@unit          conf_fn_arg_inline     NA       Rd is declared beside the program; the unit's type does not conform to it
@unit          conf_meth_arg          NA       Rd is declared beside the program; the unit's type does not conform to it
@unit          conf_meth_arg_qual     NA       Rd is declared beside the program; the unit's type does not conform to it
@unit          conf_dispatch_arg      NA       Rd is declared beside the program; the unit's type does not conform to it
@unit          conf_operator          NA       Rd is declared beside the program; the unit's type does not conform to it
@unit          conf_field_borrow      NA       Rd is declared beside the program; the unit's type does not conform to it
@unit          conf_field_owned       NA       Rd is declared beside the program; the unit's type does not conform to it
@unit          conf_list              NA       Rd is declared beside the program; the unit's type does not conform to it
@unit          conf_reassign          NA       Rd is declared beside the program; the unit's type does not conform to it

@unit          conf_create_return_arm NA       Rd is declared beside the program; the unit's type does not conform to it

# -- a value with no name, hoisted so its address can be taken: the cells its
#    named twin cannot write, it cannot either
map            lent_operator          NA       Map declares no operator
option         lent_operator          NA       Option declares no operator
result         lent_operator          NA       Result declares no operator
set            lent_operator          NA       Set declares no operator
option         lent_method_arg        NA       Option declares no method with an argument
result         lent_method_arg        NA       Result declares no method with an argument
option         field_rvalue_method_arg NA      Option declares no method with an argument
result         field_rvalue_method_arg NA      Result declares no method with an argument

@sum           lent_predicate         RUN
@generic       conf_create_return_arm NA       a generic conforms through a generic spec per instance; gprotocol and gfacet cover it
@interface     conf_create_return_arm NA       an interface value is already a projection; it conforms to nothing
@native        conf_create_return_arm NA       a native type declares no conformance

# -- known defects: each cell waits on its fix (the M2 worklist)
